# Local operational derivative

Complete tree-sitter-gsed0.4.0 sources are retained unchanged under upstream/.
Generated BRE/ERE parsers, node inventories and parser ABI headers are pristine.
The active scanner uses transactional fixed16-byte state restoration, checked
allocation and group overflow, bounded loop exits, scoped work and cancellation.
The owned Rc Rust bridge is the qualified isolated host with only include paths
and its normalized source identity updated for this package layout.

BRE is the registered static file-text frontend. ERE tables/entrypoint remain
explicitly available to this local wrapper; no dialect is inferred from source,
shebang or path. Neither parse success nor scanner qualification establishes
Sed label definitions, RefersTo, raw GNU execution or whole-language semantics.
